vocab.example: The book is a work of fiction and not intended as a historical account.
vocab.cn_example: 这本书是一部小说作品而并非史实陈述。

vocab.definition: a story that is told with sound and moving pictures
vocab.example: a roll of film
vocab.cn_example: 一卷胶片

vocab.definition: a large thin paper book with articles and photos
vocab.example: She has written articles for several women's magazines.
vocab.cn_example: 她为几家女性杂志撰稿。

vocab.definition: a special ability that can seem to make impossible things happen
vocab.example: Although the film was made 50 years ago, it has lost none of its magic.
vocab.cn_example: 这部电影虽然拍摄于50年前，但至今魅力仍丝毫未减。

vocab.definition: a film made to be shown at a theater or on television
vocab.example: My favourite movie is "Casablanca".
vocab.cn_example: 我最喜爱的电影是《卡萨布兰卡》。

vocab.definition: someone who paints pictures
vocab.example: He was a painter and poet.
vocab.cn_example: 他是一位画家兼诗人。

vocab.definition: a picture made by using a camera
vocab.example: a colour/black-and-white photograph
vocab.cn_example: 彩色／黑白照片

vocab.definition: a drawing, painting, or photographs of something or someone
vocab.example: Freddy drew/painted a picture of my dog.
vocab.cn_example: 弗雷迪给我的狗画了一张像。

vocab.definition: to introduce and show it
vocab.example: She presents the late-night news.
vocab.cn_example: 她主播深夜新闻。

vocab.definition: a show on television or the radio
vocab.example: a computer program
vocab.cn_example: 计算机程序

vocab.definition: popular music that expresses deep feelings
vocab.cn_meaning: 精神；热情，真挚情感；高尚情操；气魄
vocab.example: If you can't enjoy this music you've got no soul.
vocab.cn_example: 如果你不能欣赏这种音乐，说明你缺乏真挚的情感。

vocab.definition: to move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker
vocab.example: Have you come far?
vocab.cn_example: 你是远道来的吗？

vocab.definition: not like something or someone else, or not like before
vocab.example: The same hue will look different in different light.
vocab.cn_example: 同一颜色在不同光线下看起来会不同。

vocab.definition: a group of events or actions that are planned to happen one after the other
vocab.example: Her new series is a smash hit.
vocab.cn_example: 她的新系列节目极为成功，引起轰动。

vocab.definition: having a natural ability to do something well
vocab.cn_meaning: 有才能的；能干的；技艺高超的
vocab.example: Howard is a talented pianist.
vocab.cn_example: 霍华德是一名有天赋的钢琴家。

vocab.definition: to use something that belongs to someone else and that you must give back to them later
vocab.example: Can I borrow your calculator?
vocab.cn_example: 我可以借用你的计算器吗？

vocab.definition: in a lower place or position than something else
vocab.cn_meaning: 在较低处；在某平面之下；（位置）低于
vocab.example: From the top of the skyscraper the cars below us looked like insects.
vocab.cn_example: 从摩天大楼顶上往下看，下面的汽车小得像昆虫一样。

vocab.definition: a large natural hole in a mountain or under the ground
vocab.example: After protests from customers, the company caved and removed the item from its stores.
vocab.cn_example: 在顾客们进行抗议后，公司妥协了，从货架上拿下了这件商品。

vocab.definition: a white or gray mass in the sky made of small drops of water
vocab.example: Do you think those are rain clouds on the horizon?
vocab.cn_example: 你看天边那些云是雨云吗？

vocab.definition: land that is not in towns or cities and has farms and fields
vocab.example: The countryside around there is beautiful.
vocab.cn_example: 那周围的乡村很美。

vocab.definition: anything that makes things not clean, such as earth or soil
vocab.example: His coat was covered with dirt.
vocab.cn_example: 他的外套上满是泥土。

vocab.definition: a thick cloud just above the ground or sea
vocab.example: Alcohol fogs the brain.
vocab.cn_example: 酒精使头脑发昏。

vocab.definition: a substance such as air, which is neither solid nor liquid
vocab.example: Oxygen, hydrogen, and nitrogen are all gases.
vocab.cn_example: 氧气、氢气和氮气都是气体。

vocab.definition: to take a long walk, usually in the countryside
vocab.example: The recent hike in train fares came as a shock to commuters.
vocab.cn_example: 最近火车票的涨价让通勤的人们十分震惊。

vocab.definition: a thick forest in a hot country, with many large plants growing close together
vocab.example: The Yanomami people live in the South American jungle.
vocab.cn_example: 雅诺马密人生活在南美丛林中。

vocab.definition: a sudden falsh of light in the sky, caused by electricity
vocab.example: thunder and lightning
vocab.cn_example: 雷电

vocab.definition: a position, building, town, or area
vocab.example: University is a great place for making new friends.
vocab.cn_example: 大学是结交新朋友的好地方。

vocab.definition: a small, hard thing made by plants, from which a new plant grows
vocab.example: Sow the seeds (= put them in the ground) about three centimetres deep.
vocab.cn_example: 把这些种子种进约3厘米深的地方。

vocab.definition: an animal with a long, thin body and no legs, that can bite
vocab.example: He's terrified of being bitten by a snake.
vocab.cn_example: 他很害怕被蛇咬。

vocab.definition: white pieces of frozen water that fall down from the sky
vocab.example: It's snowing.
vocab.cn_example: 下雪了。

vocab.definition: the hot mist that water produces when it is boiled
vocab.example: Steam rose from the simmering stew.
vocab.cn_example: 炖着的肉咕嘟咕嘟冒着热气。

vocab.definition: a time in the evening when you last see the sun in the sky
vocab.example: The fishermen set out at sunset for a night's fishing.
vocab.cn_example: 渔夫们日落时分出海，准备夜间捕鱼。

vocab.definition: the light and heat from the sun
vocab.example: The children were out playing in the sunshine.
vocab.cn_example: 孩子们正在外面太阳下玩耍。

vocab.definition: how hot or cold a place or thing is
vocab.example: Preheat the oven to a temperature of 200 degrees Celsius.
vocab.cn_example: 把炉子预热到200摄氏度。

vocab.definition: the loud noise that you hear during a storm
vocab.example: a clap of thunder
vocab.cn_example: 一声雷响

vocab.definition: moving air, especially when it moves strongly or quickly
vocab.example: There isn't enough wind to fly a kite.
vocab.cn_example: 风不够大，风筝飞不起来。

vocab.definition: to have existence or come into existence
vocab.example: That doesn't happen very often.
vocab.cn_example: 那不常发生。

vocab.definition: to break up and move soil using a tool, a machine, or your hands
vocab.example: She gave him a dig in the ribs.
vocab.cn_example: 她轻轻地戳了一下他的肋部。

vocab.definition: feeling fear worry about the possible results of a particular situation
vocab.cn_meaning: 畏惧的，害怕的;担忧的，发愁的
vocab.example: I'm afraid you guessed wrong.
vocab.cn_example: 恐怕你猜错了。

vocab.definition: to choose something
vocab.example: It's up to you to decide.
vocab.cn_example: 这事由你来决定吧。

vocab.definition: to strike it quickly and with force
vocab.example: They were going about 60 kilometres an hour when their car hit the tree.
vocab.cn_example: 他们的车撞到树上时正以约每小时60公里的车速行驶。
